dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent O-shaped and C-shaped structures on the mid-flank exhibit high-contrast light perimeters surrounding low-intensity dark cores. The geometry is predominantly elliptical with a soft gradient transition from the dark exterior hide to the light-intensity ring edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid, high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients or dark cores, concentrated primarily along the dorsal ridge and the shoulder region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest lateral O-shaped annuli form a non-equilateral trapezoidal pattern; the smaller dorsal blobs align in a curved linear formation following the upper contour of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Linear, high-aspect-ratio green occlusions are present in the lower right quadrant; high-intensity fine-line projections (vibrissae) are visible extending from the anterior facial region.
